resources.string: Your data exists only on this phone. Export a backup file regularly and keep it somewhere safe, such as a USB drive or another device. If the app is uninstalled or the phone is lost, data without a backup cannot be recovered.
Save all data to a file you choose
Replace all data with a backup file
Recommended. AES-256 encryption; without the passphrase the file cannot be opened.
There is no way to recover a forgotten passphrase.
All current data on this phone will be replaced. This cannot be undone.
This file is not a Hayat backup.
This backup was made by a newer or unsupported version of Hayat.
Wrong passphrase, or the file is damaged.
The backup file is damaged or incomplete. Nothing was changed.
The file is too large to be a Hayat backup.
The file could not be read or written.
